title: Windows: sync with Linux 0.1.16 — stable identity, relative mouse, media keys, controller mode
highlights: Stable device identity via Bonjour TXT id — no more duplicate rows in Devices after reinstall or rename.
Relative mouse injection with sub-pixel accumulation for smooth pointer movement.
Fixed absolute coordinate mapping (removed VIRTUALDESK flag) — cursor lands precisely on 1080p, 1440p and 4K screens.
Media keys (volume, mute, play/pause, next, previous, stop) forwarded from Mac and Linux controllers.
Controller mode: virtual cursor, ClipCursor confinement, Raw Input, media key capture.
File transfers: ack routed on delivering connection; 15-second timeout with graceful fallback.
